cover: Gulf shipping burns under fire while missile strikes shake Kyiv
cover_scene: Thick black plumes of smoke rise over commercial tankers in a narrow shipping strait under an ominous crimson sunset.

slides.scene: Several large oil tankers ablaze in the narrow waters of the Persian Gulf as naval vessels maneuver through heavy smoke.
slides.headline: Tankers Struck in Strategic Gulf Strait
slides.body: Multiple oil tankers caught fire or suffered severe damage across the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz amid escalating military actions. Iranian forces claimed strikes on passing vessels while regional drone attacks simultaneously hit Saudi Arabian transit infrastructure.

slides.scene: Emergency response vehicles with flashing blue lights navigate a shattered boulevard in Kyiv illuminated by burning buildings after a night missile impact.
slides.headline: Russian Ballistic Missiles Strike Ukrainian Capital
slides.body: Russian ballistic missiles battered medical and transport infrastructure across Kyiv, injuring dozens including children and destroying fleets of ambulances. The barrage struck just hours after Moscow signaled tentative willingness to resume diplomatic negotiations with Washington.

slides.scene: A reinforced concrete guard post along the Korean Demilitarized Zone with high-powered loudspeaker banks aimed across the barbed wire line.
slides.headline: North Korea Prepares Border Propaganda Broadcasts
slides.body: Pyongyang began reinstalling and readying massive loudspeaker arrays along the demilitarized border to resume psychological warfare against South Korea. The provocation follows a severe deterioration in bilateral ties despite Seoul urging immediate diplomatic de-escalation.

slides.scene: A dark federal courtroom with mahogany benches, a raised judge bench, and scale of justice in dramatic lighting.
slides.headline: Judge Orders Trump Deposition in Defamation Suit
slides.body: A federal judge ordered Donald Trump to testify under oath in his ten billion dollar defamation lawsuit against the BBC. The legal battle stems from edited documentary coverage, forcing formal depositions as pretrial proceedings advance.
